method: Exact official page-title matching is preferred over download links because several original Wiki download fields point to another work. The one nonmatching catalogue title is joined by its exact public download URL; retain the established catalogue title and record originalTitle. The four other Wiki pages have distinct official titles and download IDs from all 37 catalogue rows and receive stable Wiki page IDs without invented numbers.
